native_record_key: GKGRECORDID; logical article key is normalized DocumentIdentifier URL
completeness_rule: Fetch every aligned 15-minute GKG ZIP in the requested half-open window; require one bounded 27-column GKG CSV entry per ZIP. A missing file fails the entire window.

admission_evidence.completeness_rule: One GKG ZIP per aligned 15-minute interval; all requested files required

notes: GDELT dataset metadata is permitted for commercial use and republication with attribution to The GDELT Project and https://www.gdeltproject.org/. Project request cap 160/day is an operational budget, not a publisher guarantee. Do not retain global ZIP/CSV responses or fetch article bodies. GKG DATE is processing time; original publication and incident times remain null without separate evidence. Victoria location mentions are candidates; official area normalization retains mentioned_place or unknown and never invents a point. First release covers only explicitly collected windows; global source availability from 2015 is not local historical coverage. Normalized metadata retention is 30 days.
